cat > $O/REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# Repo snapshot: sample

## Purpose

Sample is a Rust-native, self-bootstrapping agent harness shipped as a single binary that works with any LLM. A user states a goal with `sample run --goal "..."`, and the agent plans tasks, builds the skills it needs, spawns sub-agents and then evolves its own prompts and skills through a 5-gate self-evolution engine. A WebSocket gateway and a Gateway-compatible control plane let operators watch, approve and redirect work. The README marks it as a v0.1.0 release candidate with a TUI still to come.
